user.title: Proflame 2 fireplace
user.description: Pick the Broadlink RM Pro that will transmit, then paste one code learned from your handheld remote (Broadlink base64, or the text of a Flipper Zero RAW .sub file). The remote's serial and checksum are read from it.

data_description.temperature_sensor: The fireplace has no sensor of its own; the handheld remote measures the room. Pick a sensor in the same room and a thermostat entity is added.

error.invalid_capture: No valid Proflame 2 packet found in that capture.

abort.already_configured: This remote serial is already set up.

data_description.resend_minutes: The handheld remote repeats its state every few minutes. 0 turns this off.
data_description.temperature_sensor: The fireplace has no sensor of its own; the handheld remote measures the room. Pick a sensor in the same room and a thermostat entity is added.
data_description.smart_span: How far below target the room must be for flame 6. The flame steps down evenly as the room warms; 6 °F means one level per degree.
data_description.smart_min_flame: Smart never burns lower than this while heating.
data_description.hysteresis: How far past a threshold the room must go before the flame changes or shuts off. Stops rapid cycling.
